text: so the quads are different size but the geometry is the same size? because its on a 6 sided cylinder, and the cylinder i believe is not modified in any which direction, so 2 sides show on the uv as one size while 4 the other
resolution: Confirmed the user’s cylinder diagnosis against the live rear-indicator geometry and the immutable uv-reset record. All six wall quads are physically equal at approximately 0.00104 square metres each. The UV builder uses dominant-world-axis box projection and explicitly accepts projection-cosine compression on glancing faces. Consequently four angled sides project to about 0.02252 m across while two axis-aligned sides retain the full 0.026 m width; the atlas then groups them as 2 + 1 + 2 + 1 charts. The reset UV already shows roughly 36 versus 40 square texels per equal quad, and the current layout shows about 180 versus 216. No geometry or UV mutation was made.
